versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ym-game-design-doc (游戏策划案生成器).
- Produces concise indie game design documents including core loops, key systems (MVP/后期), numbers framework, art estimates, milestones, and risk control.
- Inputs: game concept, platform (default: PC), team size (default: solo, 15h/week), and optional dev cycle.
- Follows strict template structure; ensures scope can be finished with available team capacity.
- Risk list includes specific cutdown strategies; final output includes total workload and people-month estimate.
- Does not include any code, art creation, or commercial analysis.
